title: Other apps from the developer
description: Independent iOS apps built by Gül Eda Aydemir.

items.title: SOLO.SHOTS
items.summary: Take one photo a day, watch a year become a timelapse. Offline-first and private.

items.title: Solo.Shoots
items.summary: Shoot yourself properly. Your Apple Watch becomes the remote, the timer and the viewfinder.

items.title: Solo.Swipe
items.summary: Clear the camera roll one swipe at a time. Reclaim the storage you keep ignoring.

items.title: DUMP
items.summary: Turn photos and video into Instagram carousels and collages without opening a design tool.

items.title: Solora
items.summary: A productivity app that adapts to the role you're in, instead of one rigid system for every part of your life.

items.title: Solo.Surya
items.summary: Vedic astrology charts and daily readings, calculated on device with no connection required.

items.title: GeoZaza
items.summary: A geography quiz worth playing twice. Solo runs, live duels and online matches.
